description: Issue 1117 Si(110) 4.15 MeV order-+-2 study (Gridnev 1987 photo 4b). Local contrast as in planar-exit-1109-study.json (theta_y=0 cut or marginal, order m over its mean on 0.15<|theta_x/s-m|<0.35), orders -3..3 because a tilt breaks the +-m symmetry. mechanisms [] is the coherent zero-kernel control on the same Bloch grid. incidence_rad tilts the in-plane beam axis. beam_mixture [[weight, sigma_rad], ...] is an incoherent mixture of Gaussians round in (theta_x, theta_y). window_contrast[w] averages the cut over |theta_y| <= w (21-point Simpson). Total energy convention. checks/planar_exit_out_of_plane.py on qlmc RTX 5080 (CuPy), SLURM array 11451; 128 cells, max_order 8, dz 20 A, eta steps 0.05/0.2/1.0 A (coarse step capped at a quarter of the widest component's Gaussian width).
